title: Two asymptotically flat spinning black holes balanced by their self-interacting, synchronised scalar hair
summary: Asymptotically flat balanced configurations of two spinning black holes with synchronised scalar hair (2sBHs) are possible (arXiv:2305.15467). These are constructed within a generalized Bach-Weyl framework and arise from two spinning boson stars (2sBSs) by placing a horizon at the center of each component. Here, we investigate the effects of quartic scalar self-interactions on this family of solutions, comprising the 2sBSs, the 2sBHs, and an intermediate configuration--single spinning black hole with quadrupolar scalar hair (1sBHs).
